title: SA/148/2013 of Sanathan Dharam Pratinidhi Sabha Punjab Vs Kailash Chandra Bhatt AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SA No.148/2013
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
None
None turns up on behalf of the
appellant even in the revised call.
This appeal is pending since
27.9.2013 for admission.
Registry has been pointed out
some defect and despite of granting
several opportunities from 27.9.2013 up
till the day, such defect has not been
removed.
This appeal is hereby dismissed in
non-prosecution.
